profiles.name: best_runtime_latency
profiles.notes: Small 128k-context model from NVIDIA's catalog. Live benchmark from this workspace timed out in both JSON and stream mode on 2026-05-07, so it is not the default.

profiles.name: instant_long_context
profiles.notes: Small current default with 128k context. Live benchmark on 2026-05-09 had the fastest useful stream result among the bundled chat profiles: 0.326s first token and 0.338s total for a tiny reply.

profiles.name: balanced_long_context
profiles.notes: 8B long-context option. It was fast in an older discovery benchmark, but timed out in the 2026-05-09 bundled profile stream check and is no longer the default.

profiles.name: tool_planner_latency
profiles.notes: Chosen for compact JSON tool planning on 2026-05-09. Live Jarvis probes stayed grounded on multi-tool prompts with about 1.4-1.8s first content.

profiles.name: memory_json_latency
profiles.notes: Small fast JSON model used for background memory extraction. It is fast, but compact planner live tests on 2026-05-09 were less grounded than mistral-nemotron.

profiles.name: vector_memory_embedding_latency
profiles.notes: Fastest successful QA-style embedding model in the live workspace check on 2026-05-08: about 0.395s for a small passage embedding. Used through NVIDIA_EMBEDDING_MODEL for vector memory.

profiles.name: nemotron_fast_agentic
profiles.notes: Hybrid Transformer-Mamba NVIDIA model aimed at efficient reasoning and agentic tasks.

profiles.name: llama_strong_runtime
profiles.notes: 70B long-context option. Strong model, but the broader live discovery stream benchmark picked the 8B model for lower latency.
